thread:
alex_dc: morning async — quick status on routeplane migration, auth token rotation, and rate-limit policy rollouts. what I did / blockers / today

maria_pf: done - migrated 40% of routes to routeplane in staging. saw 504 spikes for long tail requests, investigating.

sam_k: looked at the 504s — they correlate with long streaming responses + small batch sizes. increasing batch window helped in my local repro.

alex_dc: noted. blocker: need a quick config change to allow 300ms extra batching for streaming routes, but want to avoid impacting p99 for short requests. cc @maria_pf @jordan_ops

jordan_ops: can canary that change on the dedicated pool. I can flip flag for pool-gw-2 for 30m window. schedule? :calendar:

maria_pf: pls canary after I finish token rotation tests (10–15m). token rotation revealed an edge case where expired tokens returned 401 but gateway sent 429 to clients — mapping bug.

sam_k: short fix: map 401 from auth service -> 401 to client. currently we translate into 429 when auth service times out. patch ready, small one-liner in auth-proxy.

alex_dc: paste snippet for the rate tweak and auth mapping:

```
# gateway config (yaml)
routes:
  - match: "/api/*"
    routeplane: enabled
    rate_limit:
      unit: requests
      value: 100
    batch:
      streaming_extra_ms: 300  # canary change
auth:
  upstream_timeout_ms: 2500
  map_unauth_to_client: true  # fix: map upstream 401->401
```

jordan_ops: ok i'll canary batch tweak on pool-gw-2 at +15m after token tests. will monitor 99/95/50 and deployments panel.

tina: quick heads-up — tests for KMS key rotation passed, but logs show repeated warn: "kv-cache miss" for embeddings route, might be due to new routeplane keying. I'll open a short PR to relax cache keys.

alex_dc: thanks. items for today:
- canary batch tweak (jordan_ops)
- merge auth-proxy 1-line fix (sam_k)
- token rotation smoke (maria_pf)
- follow-up on kv-cache (tina)

sam_k: i'll open PR now, assign to @alex_dc for quick review.

deploy-bot: deploy started: svc/gateway-v2 canary -> pool-gw-2 (2/5 hosts). :rocket:

maria_pf: will post smoke results in here when done.

alex_dc: cool. if p99 spikes, rollback flag is `gw.batch.streaming_extra_ms=0`. let's keep the window small during canary. ping in ~30m. :thumbsup:
